section.title: org.osgi.service.resourcemonitoring.monitor
section.para: Resource Monitoring Monitor Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.resourcemonitoring.monitor; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.resourcemonitoring.monitor; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

listitem.para: CPUMonitor - A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_CPU} resource type.
DiskStorageMonitor - A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_DISK_STORAGE} resource type.
MemoryMonitor - A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_MEMORY} resource type.
SocketMonitor - A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_SOCKET} resource type.
ThreadMonitor - A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_THREADS} resource type.

section.title: public abstract CPUMonitor extends ResourceMonitor<Long>
section.para: A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_CPU} resource type. CPUMonitor instance monitors the CPU consumed by a {@link ResourceContext} instance.

section.title: public abstract long getCPUUsage()
section.para: Returns the CPU usage as a cumulative number of nanoseconds
The {@link #getUsage()} method returns the same value, wrapped in a long.

section.title: public abstract DiskStorageMonitor extends ResourceMonitor<Long>
section.para: A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_DISK_STORAGE} resource type. A DiskStorageMonitor instance monitors and limits the persistent storage of the bundle belonging to the {@link ResourceContext}

section.title: public abstract long getUsedDiskStorage()
section.para: Returns the sum of the size of the persistent storage areas of the bundles in this resource context.
The {@link #getUsage()} method returns the same value, wrapped in a long.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the sum of the sizes of the persistent storage areas in bytes

section.title: public abstract MemoryMonitor extends ResourceMonitor<Long>
section.para: A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_MEMORY} resource type. A MemoryMonitor instance monitors and limits the memory used by a {@link ResourceContext} instance.

section.title: public abstract long getMemoryUsage()
section.para: Returns the size of the java heap used by the bundles in this resource context.
The {@link #getUsage()} method returns the same value, wrapped in a long.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the size of the used java heap in bytes

section.title: public abstract SocketMonitor extends ResourceMonitor<Long>
section.para: A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_SOCKET} resource type. {@link SocketMonitor} instance are used to monitor and limit the number of in-use sockets per {@link ResourceContext} instance. {@link SocketMonitor} instance handle all types of sockets (TCP, UDP, ...).

A TCP socket is considered to be in-use when it is bound ( {@link Socket#bind(java.net.SocketAddress)}) or when it is connected ( {@link Socket#connect(java.net.SocketAddress)}). It leaves the in-use state when the socket is closed ({@link Socket#close()}). *

A UDP socket is in-use when it is bound ( {@link DatagramSocket#bind(java.net.SocketAddress)}) or connected ( {@link DatagramSocket#connect(java.net.SocketAddress)}). A UDP Socket leaves the in-use state when it is closed ({@link DatagramSocket#close()}).

section.title: public abstract long getSocketUsage()
section.para: Returns the number of existing socket created by a {@link ResourceContext}.
The {@link #getUsage()} method returns the same value, wrapped in a long.

section.title: public abstract ThreadMonitor extends ResourceMonitor<Integer>
section.para: A {@link ResourceMonitor} for the {@link ResourceMonitoringService#RES_TYPE_THREADS} resource type. A ThreadMonitor instance monitors and limits the thread created by a {@link ResourceContext} instance.

section.title: public abstract int getAliveThreads()
section.para: Returns the number of alive threads created by the bundles in this resource context. A Thread is considered to be alive when its java state is one of the following:
The {@link #getUsage()} method returns the same value, wrapped in a int.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the number of alive threads created by this resource context
